title: Fri. 6/13 > Mass Pike Overpass Standout in Westfield - Southampton Rd (Routes 10/202)
description:
Wow! What a great location for a standout! On 5/30, around 17 people, including a bagpiper!  What a blast! LOTS of engagement with motorists!

There's lots and lots of traffic passing by. Southampton Road (Routes 10/202) is heavily traveled northbound and southbound, and the Mass Pike eastbound and westbound is below. Lots of honks and thumbs up and waves...and a few folks flying middle fingers. We smile and wave at them all! 

We'll have letterboards prepared for the lower part of the overpass fencing - the photo shows how that will look to folks passing on the Mass Pike. We're interacting with motorists on the Mass Pike, and on Southampton Road. We've discovered that the magic happens when we smile and wave to people!

Come when you can, and leave when you must. You needn't be present for the entire 1 1/2 hours.

### How to Get There

The address "130 Southampton Road, Westfield" will get you just north of the overpass. 

### Parking

We can't park in the Southampton Rd breakdown lane. There are vacant business properties north of the bridge, and it seems that parking would be OK there.

It looks like The Wealth Technology Group has vacated their office at 130 Southampton Rd, but the internet says that other businesses are located there, so please be mindful if you decide to park there.

### Etiquette!

We don't give the finger to people who give the finger to us, or who say unpleasant things. We smile and wave to them, too. 

We may see a counter protester. If so, the best thing to do is just ignore them and spend our time and energy waving to motorists. Let's keep things 100% non-confrontational in words and body language.

### Other Stuff

Please take everything you brought away with you, and leave the site totally clean.

If rain is predicted, we'll cancel. If we cancel, you'll receive an email notification.

### A Few Requests

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

And, if you have an extra 3' x 5' American flag you're not using, we'd love it if you'd pass it on to us!

Signs

Make your message clear: Federal, state, and local issues of concern to you, your family, the community…there are just so many issues my head would explode if I wrote them all down. Pre-made signs will not be available for this event.

Monetary Donations

We will march to Tuscora Park from the Tuscarawas County Courthouse and then share a covered dish and/or just bring something for yourself/your family, your own paper products/utensils, snacks to share, and good conversation with those joining us. If you bring something to share, please be mindful of allergies. An index card with a list of ingredients taped to the container would be appreciated. Label containers with your name if you want them back! Jenn Schrock will oversee the food/refreshments while we march.

Half of a covered pavilion near the bocce courts has been reserved for this event. Blankets and chairs can be dropped off beforehand. For those that do not have a way back to the courthouse to march, Alicia Hall will help transport people to the courthouse BEFORE the march once they drop off their items at the park.

Rally, March and Sign-Waving:

Flat sidewalks and accessible street crossings make this a  good site for people with mobility challenges.

We encourage the use of public transit and carpooling. Metro buses stop at the south end of the park (N 175th St) and the north end (N 185th St), and buses run north and south along Aurora Ave N. 
Some parking is available along side streets between N 175th and N 185th. PLEASE do not park at Shoreline City Hall: we have paid only to use "Sculpture Park". Another group has rented the outdoor space at City Hall itself. They have use of the parking there: we do not.
There are no public bathrooms, but there are bathrooms at many of the businesses adjacent to the park (Starbucks, Orange Julius, etc). Be prepared to make a small purchase in order to use the facilities.

Security: Everyday Activists volunteers will be on hand to answer questions, provide assistance, and administer basic first aid. Look for the folks in the tasteful yellow safety vests.

title: NO KINGS! Bloomsburg March & Rally
description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings. In Bloomsburg, join Sunrise Bloomsburg and Action Together NEPA for a march up Market Street followed by a rally at the Columbia County Courthouse to say NO KINGS IN AMERICA!**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*


**BLOOMSBURG EVENT INFORMATION**
This action will include a march and a rally. The march will begin at the Bloomsburg Town Park (meet in the parking lot at the end of Market Street), go up Market, and end at the Columbia County Courthouse at 35 West Main Street. 


If you'd like to join the march but don't want or aren't able to walk the whole length, feel free to join us anywhere along Market Street! Some folks will be gathering and joining from the closed Social Security Office at 700 Market Street, or join from any spot along the way!

Following the march, we will have a rally with speakers at the Columbia County Courthouse, which will begin at approximately 1:30pm (slightly flexible depending upon marchers' arrival). You may also feel free to join us directly at the Courthouse beginning at 1pm. 

Please dress comfortably-wear lightweight clothing and shoes comfortable for walking/standing. There are spots to sit at the Courthouse, but if you'd like to be guaranteed a place to sit, we would recommend bringing a folding lawn chair. Organizers will provide water and snacks. 

**BRING SIGNS! **
Get creative with your signs - homemade handwritten signs are always the coolest! If you need some ideas, here are a few: 

NO KINGS IN AMERICA!

Stop the Shakedown!

United Against Kings

We are Not For Sale!

No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.

title: Juneteenth Weekend of Action Virtual Phone Bank
description:
Join us for a non-partisan Juneteenth Weekend of Action Virtual Phone Bank as we make sure every voice is heard in the Florida SD15/HD 40 Special Election!

On Friday, June 20, 2025, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM EST, we’ll be calling voters who haven’t yet participated in early voting to remind them that Election Day is tomorrow. This is a critical opportunity to boost voter turnout and ensure our communities are fully represented at the ballot box.

📞 No experience necessary! We'll provide the script, training, and support—you bring your passion and commitment to civic engagement.

✅ This is a non-partisan event. All outreach will be strictly focused on encouraging participation, not on promoting any candidate or party.

Let’s make an impact together! Sign up to be part of this important effort to empower voters in Florida Senate District 15 and House District 40.
